claim_text: Owned control-plane architecture for a governed agentic AI platform, delivering a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows across regulated financial clients.

Drove CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions for reusable AI platform commercialization, aligning consumption-based licensing and deal support to enterprise workflow adoption goals using CFO-aligned adoption motions.
Established audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows through evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
Standardized the AI systems lifecycle through managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design, compressing lab-to-production cycle time from six months to three weeks.
Architected distributed cloud data runtime integration patterns across Databricks, vector services, and API gateways to sustain high-availability agentic workloads.
Commercialized reusable AI platform capability through an agentic operating model, scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28 while advancing platform productization.
